description: Shared update policy for JanWelker's repositories. See README.md.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refreshes every transitive package at once and has no release timestamp to age, so it opens on Mondays, a whole-day window Renovate cannot miss, and waits for a human.

packageRules.description: Everything below a major merges on its own once the required ci-ok check is green.
A major opens at 19:00 Zurich time and waits for a human to merge it.
Below 1.0 a minor is the breaking release, so it waits for a human like a major.

These registries publish no release timestamps, so a required timestamp would hold their updates forever and no age can be enforced; they skip the release age altogether, which also keeps the dashboard free of the timestamp-optional warnings, and third-party images there wait for a human instead.
Our own images: no release age to wait out.
Our own reusable workflows and presets: no release age to wait out.
TypeScript stays on 6.x everywhere: 7 is the native Go port, and the Svelte and typescript-eslint toolchains do not support it yet.
